uses.quote: Unacknowledged use of Artiﬁcial Intelligence: Where artiﬁcial intelligence has been used to support the assessment without proper acknowledgement.
Falsiﬁcation by Artiﬁcial Intelligence: A misrepresentation of knowledge. Where a student used artiﬁcial intelligence to complete the assessment [in part or full].
Falsiﬁcation: the presentation of ﬁctitious or distorted documents, data, evidence or any other material, including submitting the work of another person as if it is their own.
Plagiarism: the use of ideas, intellectual property or work of others without acknowledgement or, where relevant, permission.
